principles: Collision geometry is independent from visual GLB geometry and LOD.
Never use high-poly render meshes as runtime colliders.
Conveyor items are moved by deterministic logistics, not mutually colliding rigid bodies.
Only vehicles and other explicitly dynamic gameplay objects receive dynamic rigid bodies.
Unknown dimensions and connection points remain unverified until measured in-game.

implementedNow.staticColliderSource: Convex hulls generated from the transformed vertices of the largest mesh components of each streamed GLB model; static bodies are removed when models stream out.
dynamicBodies: Rapier dynamic capsule for the player
streamedWorldCategories: items with a reviewed default variant
implementedNow.collisionPolicy: Rendered GLB geometry provides the points for several low-poly convex hull colliders per object. A bounding-box fallback is used only when a valid hull cannot be generated. Terrain and the landing pad use dedicated fixed colliders.
